description:

title: Associate Analyst - Cyber Defence Center
description:
**PURPOSE AND SCOPE:**

India Cybersecurity Operation Center will assist in 24x7 Cyber Security Intrusion Monitoring and Event/Incident Response. Working with multiple IT Operations teams and members of the Information Security office, they will perform day-to-day security functions and investigations including more advanced analysis of threat intelligence and the security posture of systems. Manages and oversees systems to protect data from unauthorized access. Creates and implements policies and procedures for identifying, recording, and addressing security violations. Evaluates security systems and applications and suggests enhancements. Additional duties include gathering metrics and key performance indicators (KPI's) and other security related tasks.

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **SOC Monitoring & Incident Response:** Support a global 24x7 Security Operations Center by performing real-time security alert monitoring, initial triage, investigation, ticket management, and escalation of actionable incidents. Provide support to Incident Response activities in accordance with established processes and playbooks.
* **Security Analysis & Threat Detection:** Analyze and correlate security alerts, events, logs, vulnerabilities, and threat indicators. Demonstrate a good understanding of common cyber threats, attack techniques, malware, phishing, credential attacks, vulnerabilities, and basic security investigation methodologies.
* **Agentic AI & Machine Learning:** Demonstrate a good understanding of Generative AI, Agentic AI, machine learning concepts, AI agents, LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI-driven security operations. Understand how AI/ML can be applied to security alert triage, threat detection, event correlation, anomaly detection, investigation assistance, automation, and security orchestration. Awareness of risks associated with AI systems, including prompt injection, data leakage, model manipulation, and adversarial attacks, is desirable.

* **Analytical & Continuous Improvement:** Apply analytical and problem-solving skills to identify patterns, anomalies, and opportunities to improve SOC operations through AI/ML and automation. Maintain accurate investigation and ticket documentation, follow SOC procedures and SLAs, and collaborate effectively with global security teams in a 24x7 shift-based environment.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS****:**

* The physical demands and work environmental characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**EDUCATION:**

Minimum

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field

**EXPERIENCE AND REQUIRED SKILLS****:**

* **Experience:** 0–3 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, or IT administration roles. Programming and scripting experience is preferred.
* **Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare and contribute to incident reports, technical documentation, and operational communications.
* **Analytical Skills:** Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate security events and identify relevant findings.
* **Documentation & Attention to Detail:** Strong documentation skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail when handling security incidents, tickets, and operational activities.
* **Global Collaboration:** Ability to work effectively with geographically distributed teams across different time zones in a collaborative and 24x7 operational environment.

This role requires a 5-day workweek with 2 days off. Aligns with AI based detection & response workstream within Security Operations Team.

**Shift Timing:** Willingness to work in a 24x7 rotational shift environment, including nights, weekends, and holidays**.** Eligible for shift allowance for night shift coverage.

title: Associate, AI Data Scientist- Private Markets
description:
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka Team: Data Science Job Requisition #: R264031 Date posted: Nov. 02, 2026

  

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

**Build efficient, trusted agentic AI for private-markets intelligence**

**Research, build and scale advanced agentic systems and fit-for-purpose language models that turn complex information into dependable data, research and decision intelligence.**

  
  

**Your team**
=============

You will join a multidisciplinary AI and data science team focused on applying advanced AI to high-value challenges in private markets. The team brings together data science, engineering, product and domain expertise, and works closely with users to develop practical capabilities that improve how information is acquired, researched and managed.

You will work in an environment where applied research is expected to become dependable production capability. We value intellectual curiosity, rigorous experimentation, strong engineering and responsible AI, with quality, security and appropriate human oversight designed in from the start.

**Your role & impact**
======================

As an Associate, AI Data Scientist, you will be a hands-on technical contributor responsible for researching, building and scaling enterprise-grade agentic AI capabilities. Working directly with users and senior technical leaders, you will translate complex private-markets workflows into well-evaluated systems that move from experimentation to governed production and sustained adoption.

Your core mandate is to advance multi-agent LLM systems through effective agent design patterns, rigorous evaluation and disciplined model engineering. You will develop workflows that plan, retrieve, reason, use tools, verify and escalate appropriately, while selecting the simplest architecture and model that can meet the required quality, latency, cost and control objectives.

You will also help establish the lifecycle for open-source small language models and LLMs, from model discovery and benchmarking through training, adaptation, fine-tuning, deployment, monitoring and retirement. Your impact will be visible in stronger data quality, faster research, scalable automation and reusable AI capabilities that help BlackRock Preqin remain at the forefront of private-markets data and technology.

  
  

**Your responsibilities**
=========================

* Work forward-deployed with researchers, data specialists and product teams to understand workflows, frame ambiguous problems, define measurable outcomes and iterate rapidly from evidence to production.

* Research, design and deliver agentic workflows spanning planning, retrieval, tool use, structured extraction, reasoning, verification, exception handling and human escalation, using single-agent or multi-agent patterns where each is demonstrably appropriate.

* Engineer advanced agent patterns, including bounded iterative loops, reflection and critique, planner-executor and evaluator-optimizer patterns, with explicit stop conditions, budgets and safeguards that prevent unproductive or uncontrolled execution.

* Build agent and model harnesses that standardise tool interfaces, context assembly, state and memory handling, policy enforcement, tracing, replay and failure recovery.

* Determine when an agentic architecture, retrieval workflow, specialised model or deterministic service is the best fit, and validate the decision against representative tasks and simpler baselines.

* Design safe caching and reuse across retrieval, prompts, model responses, tool results and intermediate agent state, with clear cache keys, invalidation, freshness, access-control and provenance requirements.

* Build systematic evaluation harnesses using representative datasets, explicit quality dimensions, adversarial and edge-case testing, regression suites, human feedback and monitored production outcomes.

* Research and benchmark open-source SLMs and LLMs for task fit, considering quality, inference performance, cost, licensing, security, deployment constraints and operational supportability; apply fit-for-purpose routing and batching where they improve efficiency.

* Develop model-adaptation strategies using prompt and context optimisation, supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning or other suitable techniques, supported by governed dataset creation, experiment tracking, reproducibility and controlled promotion criteria.

* Operate the lifecycle for trained and fine-tuned open-source models, including data and model versioning, lineage, experiment and artifact management, evaluation gates, registry and release controls, deployment, performance and drift monitoring, rollback, retraining triggers and retirement.

* Build production-quality Python components that integrate models with enterprise data, retrieval services, APIs, workflow orchestration and human-review experiences.

* Improve grounding and trust through attribution, provenance, uncertainty handling, validation checks, access controls and clear separation of source evidence from model-generated conclusions.

* Own delivered reliability across testing, observability, latency, cost and maintainability, and diagnose model, data, prompt and orchestration failures in production.

* Document findings, reusable patterns and trade-offs; contribute to design reviews; and communicate results clearly to research, product, engineering, risk and senior stakeholders.

* Partner with engineering, product, risk, privacy, information security, legal and compliance colleagues to support responsible, secure and accountable use of AI.

  
  

**Required experience**
=======================

We are looking for a hands-on applied AI practitioner who combines strong research and modelling skills with production judgment and user-focused problem solving. You should bring:

* Strong experience building and deploying AI or machine-learning systems in an enterprise, SaaS, data-product or similarly complex environment, with evidence of taking work beyond prototypes.

* Practical depth in LLM applications and agentic systems, including retrieval, tool use, planning, orchestration, memory or state management, structured outputs, verification and evaluation of non-deterministic behaviour.

* Experience implementing and comparing bounded loops, reflection or critique, planner-executor and evaluator-optimizer patterns against simpler baselines, with measurable treatment of quality, reliability, latency, token usage, cost and failure modes.

* Experience building agent or model harnesses across tool interfaces, context and state management, orchestration, policy enforcement, testing, tracing, replay, deployment and observability.

* Hands-on experience evaluating, selecting, training or adapting open-source SLMs or LLMs, including benchmarking, governed dataset preparation, supervised or parameter-efficient fine-tuning and inference optimisation.

* Practical ModelOps experience for trained or fine-tuned models, including dataset and model lineage, experiment and artifact tracking, registries, evaluation gates, controlled release, performance and drift monitoring, rollback, retraining and retirement.

* Experience designing model routing, batching and safe caching with appropriate keying, invalidation, freshness, privacy, access-control and provenance safeguards.

* Strong grounding in modern machine learning, experimentation and statistical evaluation, with disciplined handling of train-test separation, leakage, uncertainty, reproducibility and model comparison.

* Ability to write production-quality Python and work effectively across data preparation, model development, APIs, orchestration, testing, deployment and observability.

* Experience with unstructured or multimodal information, semantic retrieval, provenance and data-quality engineering in workflows where domain experts provide ground truth and structured feedback.

* Experience working directly with users or domain specialists to turn ambiguous needs into usable capabilities and iterate based on observed workflow outcomes.

* Sound judgment on model and architecture trade-offs across efficacy, efficiency, security, licensing, maintainability and operational risk.

* Clear communication and collaborative delivery skills, with the ability to explain experiments, limitations and production trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.

* Understanding of private markets, alternative investments, financial data or adjacent institutional-investment workflows is desirable; curiosity and the ability to build domain depth quickly are essential.

* Commitment to responsible AI, data provenance, privacy, security and meaningful human control in high-trust enterprise workflows.

**Why this role**

This is an opportunity to work on consequential AI problems, real user workflows and high standards for trust. You will have meaningful hands-on ownership, direct access to users and the opportunity to turn emerging agent and model techniques into durable capabilities with enterprise reach.

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  
  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.
